messages:
Maya: Quick sync — reminder that cutoff for 0.15.x minor bumps is today 18:00 PT. Need API, runtime, console, and SDKs bumped and changelogs in place. Please drop PR links or any blockers here.

Pranav: Runtime: bump PR incoming, will open in ~15m. pinging CI ahead of time — some e2e flakiness on windows but not a code blocker.

Sasha: Console: working on the bump now. Will open PR + changelog in ~30m. Quick Q: changelog format — short bullet + runtime PR link okay, or do we need migration steps? @Zoe?

Zoe: For changelogs we expect: short summary, migration steps if any, and a link to the PR/issue. Prefix with component tag like `[console]` so release notes generator picks it up. If you paste the lines I can add them to the canonical draft.

Alex: SDKs: Node SDK ready. Python SDK bumped locally but publish pipeline is failing because PyPI token expired. If we can't publish before cutoff can we at least land the version bump commit so release tooling doesn't block?

Maya: We need version numbers updated across repos before cutoff — publishing can follow but merges should land. @eng-infra please assist with PyPI token if possible.

release-bot: Cutoff reminder: 4h 45m until minor-bump cutoff (2026-03-17 18:00:00 PDT). After cutoff the auto-gate will block merges marked as "minor-bump". Docs: https://internal/release/schedule/0.15.x

Pranav: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/812 — includes version bump to 0.15.1 and perf tweak. CI green except flaky windows test, created follow-up issue #1429. Merged and tagged v0.15.1-rc1.

Sasha: Console PR: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/401 opened. Changelog line I pasted: `- [console] Fix TypeScript path resolution for env-based builds (no migration required). See #401.` @Zoe can you add to the draft changelog?

Zoe: Added that line to `/changelogs/0.15.x.md` and normalized markdown headings. Marked as `no-migration`.

Alex: Node SDK PR merged: https://github.com/redwood/sdk-node/pull/220. Python SDK bumped in PR https://github.com/redwood/sdk-python/pull/88 but publish failed. @Sam can you help rotate/run publish?

Sam: Sam (eng-infra): Confirmed PyPI token expirations. I'll rotate token and kick off `release/publish --py` in ~10m. I can also run a manual publish if the automation still flaps.

Maya: Thanks. Quick local bump helper for folks who prefer scripted updates:
```bash
# from repo root
git checkout -b bump/0.15.1
# update package.json / pyproject versions en masse
find . -name package.json -exec sed -i 's/"version": "[0-9.]*"/"version": "0.15.1"/' {} +
find . -name pyproject.toml -exec sed -i "s/version = \"[0-9.]*\"/version = \"0.15.1\"/" {} +
git add -A && git commit -m 'chore: bump version to 0.15.1'
```

Maya: Also reminder: add `compat` note to changelog if any public API surface changed. If no API change, mark `no-migration`.

Zoe: Confirmed runtime + console changes are non-breaking. Marking release as `no-migration` across the draft. :thumbsup:

Pranav: Runtime merge pushed tags, created release candidate. Follow-up issue linked for flaky test.

Sasha: Console merged. CI green. Changelog entry in place.

Sam: Token rotated, triggered Python publish — monitoring logs: publishing step started at 2026-03-17T12:10:02Z. Will post status shortly.

Alex: Publish succeeded for Python (thanks Sam). Node pkg already published. All SDKs bumped & published.

Maya: Awesome — looks like we have all bumps landed and changelogs drafted. We'll hold until cutoff then run the release pipeline. If anything pops up DM me directly. :rocket:
